coder_notes: Glioblastoma is named in the conditions and the eligibility is recurrent high-grade glioma grade III and IV, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named. The record spells the drug Obitazidine Fumarate in the official title and Obitrexate Fumarate in the brief summary; obitazidine was taken from the title. Temozolomide is part of the single-arm combination and is coded soc_backbone. Tumour PK coded yes because CSF sampling is stated.
